agents.name: Jett

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.purpose: 2 short smokes (2.5s) to cut an angle while you cross, dash, or plant; not a controller smoke.
abilities.when: Smoke the two off-angles that watch your entry
abilities.verdict: Buy both on a full buy

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.purpose: 1 charge: reach off-angles or escape vertically; the escape tool once Tailwind is spent.
abilities.when: Take the height angle after the site is smoked
abilities.verdict: Buy: 150 for an unexpected angle

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.purpose: Activate then dash within 7.5s; recharges on 2 kills. Entry into site or bail after the first duel.
abilities.when: Dash in on the flash, or dash out after you tag
abilities.verdict: Free: dying with the dash armed is the classic Jett error

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.purpose: Eco/force-round kill tool with knives that refresh on left-click kills; take Op-like duels without buying.
abilities.when: A free gun on an eco round

agents.job_in_round: On attack Jett is first into site: she takes the opening duel, dashes out after taking damage, and lets the team trade. On defense she plays Operator or aggressive off-angles, takes one shot, and Tailwinds to safety before the swing.
good_play_looks_like: Activates Tailwind before the peek so the dash is armed the moment she takes damage
Enters first on executes right behind flashes, pulling defenders' attention while teammates trade
Op peek, one shot, dash to cover before the second enemy swings
Uses Updraft to reach an unexpected high angle, then re-pathes instead of holding it twice
Cloudburst thrown to cross a gap or cover the plant, not as a standalone site smoke
common_mistakes: Dies with Tailwind icon still lit (never armed or never used) after taking damage in the open
Dashes in with no team behind her and no flash, then dies untraded
Burns Tailwind speculatively at round start and later gets caught with no escape
Takes the Operator and then sits passively instead of taking the first shot and repositioning
Throws both Cloudbursts at once on the same angle, then has none for the plant
Right-clicks Blade Storm at range and wastes all knives without a kill
ability_checks: If Tailwind (E) is lit at death, the escape was wasted; if it is on cooldown after a kill, check that the dash was used to reposition, not to re-peek
If Updraft (Q) is lit at death after being caught in the open, the vertical escape was not used
Cloudburst (C) charges still full at the plant means no cover was made for the spike
Blade Storm ready (X lit) for several rounds with no use is a wasted eco-round kill tool
tips: Arm Tailwind before you peek, not after you are hit
Your job is the first duel, not the last; take it and get out
Save Updraft as a panic exit if Tailwind is down
Pop Blade Storm on rounds where you have no gun, not when you have a Vandal

agents.name: Phoenix

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.purpose: Curvable fire wall that blocks vision and heals Phoenix; used to split a site or self-heal.
abilities.when: Wall through the choke and run your own entry through it
abilities.verdict: Buy every round: 150 and it heals you

abilities.name: Curveball
abilities.purpose: 2 curving flashes; pop from cover to blind a corner you are about to swing.
abilities.cost: free first, 250 for the second, a charge resets every two kills
abilities.when: Curve it around the corner and swing on the count
abilities.verdict: Buy the second on a full buy

abilities.name: Hot Hands
abilities.purpose: Fireball molly: damage a corner or stand in it to heal; 1 charge, refreshes on 2 kills.
abilities.when: Molly the corner before you swing; it heals you too
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Run It Back
abilities.purpose: Free respawn marker; use to take a high-risk peek, dry entry, or scout a site for free.
abilities.when: A free entry: take the fight you would never take

agents.job_in_round: On attack Phoenix self-flashes and enters site, using Blaze to cut off crossfire and Hot Hands to clear corners. On defense he holds close angles, self-heals off his wall or molly, and uses Run It Back to take fights he could not otherwise afford.
good_play_looks_like: Curveball popped tight around the corner with an immediate swing while the flash is active
Blaze placed to divide the site so only one defender can see him at a time
Ult used on a round where the free peek gains a kill or clear information before the real push
Heals in Blaze or Hot Hands between fights when at low HP and nobody is pushing
Enters with teammates behind him ready to trade
common_mistakes: Curveball thrown wide or too early, flashing nobody or flashing himself and teammates
Blaze placed with Phoenix on the wrong side, blinding his own team
Run It Back used at round end or behind the team, gaining nothing
Sits inside Blaze or molly to heal while the site is being taken
Peeks without flashing and dies to a set angle with both Curveballs unused
Uses Hot Hands only as a heal and never to clear a corner or delay a defuse
ability_checks: If both Curveball (Q) charges are lit at death on entry, he dry-peeked with flashes available
Blaze (C) lit at death on a site hit means he took the crossfire without cutting an angle
Run It Back (X) ready for multiple rounds means the free aggressive peek is not being cashed in
Hot Hands (E) unused at low HP in a lull means the self-heal was skipped
tips: Flash then swing; never swing then flash
Stand on the correct side of your wall before you throw it
Ult is for a peek you would not take otherwise, then the real push
Heal only when the map is quiet, not mid-execute

agents.name: Reyna

abilities.name: Leer
abilities.purpose: 2 nearsight eyes (60 HP); throw above head height into site so defenders must shoot it or lose vision.
abilities.when: Leer the angle and then swing it; do not leer and wait
abilities.verdict: Buy one always, the second on a full buy

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.purpose: Consume a soul orb to heal 50 temporary HP; only when no second enemy can trade.
abilities.cost: 200, shared pool with Dismiss, needs a soul orb
abilities.when: Take the orb right after a kill if you are staying in the fight
abilities.verdict: Buy the extra charge on a full buy, but credits without kills buy nothing

abilities.name: Dismiss
abilities.purpose: Consume a soul orb to go intangible 1.5s; the reposition after a kill. Default over Devour.
abilities.cost: 200, shared pool with Devour, needs a soul orb
abilities.when: Dismiss the second you trade a kill and you are low
abilities.verdict: Same pool as Devour

abilities.name: Empress
abilities.purpose: Combat stim plus auto-Devour on kills; chain fights on a pushed site or a retake.
abilities.when: Open a round with it when you are confident, not as a comeback button

agents.job_in_round: On attack Reyna throws Leer over the site, takes the first duel, and Dismisses out of the line of fire after the kill. On defense she takes aggressive early picks and relies on Leer plus Dismiss to escape; without a kill she has no utility, so she must play with the team.
good_play_looks_like: Leer thrown at head height into site just before swinging, so it must be shot
Dismiss immediately after a kill when a second enemy is nearby, then re-peeks from a new angle
Devour used only when the area is confirmed clear
Pops Empress before entering a contested site to snowball multiple kills
Plays as a trader when she has no orbs, not as a solo entry
common_mistakes: Devours in the open and dies to a second enemy while channeling
Never uses Dismiss after a kill and gets traded standing still
Throws Leer from too far, so it is shot before anyone swings
Over-extends after a kill chasing the 3s orb window into a bad position
Activates Empress after taking heavy damage, losing the chance to Devour first
Plays as a lone wolf with no orbs and no team, dying without any impact
ability_checks: If Dismiss (E) is lit and a soul orb was available at death, the escape was wasted
Devour (Q) used with an enemy still nearby is the wrong orb choice; check if a second enemy was in frame
Both Leer (C) charges lit on a site entry means no nearsight was used before the peek
Empress (X) held for many rounds while ready is a wasted snowball tool
tips: Dismiss first, Devour never when a trade is possible
Leer above head height, tight before the swing
No orbs means you are a trader, not an entry
Empress before the site push, not after the fight

agents.name: Raze

abilities.name: Boom Bot
abilities.purpose: Ground drone that hunts and damages; clears close corners or flushes a lurker before entry.
abilities.when: Send it in first when you are entering a site blind
abilities.verdict: First to cut on a force

abilities.name: Blast Pack
abilities.purpose: 2 satchels for movement (satchel jump into site) or damage; slows now reduce mid-air force.
abilities.when: Satchel into site after the flash, or out after you trade
abilities.verdict: Buy both on a full buy: mobility, not damage

abilities.name: Paint Shells
abilities.purpose: Cluster grenade for corners, post-plant denial, or after an enemy is stalled; refreshes on 2 kills.
abilities.when: Nade the corner you know is held before you enter
abilities.verdict: Free, and it can kill outright

abilities.name: Showstopper
abilities.purpose: Rocket launcher for a guaranteed opening kill or stalling a retake; pair with a satchel jump.
abilities.when: Rocket the stacked choke or a post-plant

agents.job_in_round: On attack Raze clears close corners with Boom Bot and Paint Shells, then satchels onto site to create the opening pick. On defense she delays with utility on chokes and plays for high-damage entry denial, using Showstopper to end retakes or stop a push.
good_play_looks_like: Boom Bot sent through a likely close-corner position before the team enters
Paint Shells thrown onto a cornered or slowed enemy for a kill or forced move
Satchel jump into site timed with a flash from an initiator
Showstopper fired from an unexpected angle or mid-satchel jump
Saves a Blast Pack to break a wall of defenders in post-plant
common_mistakes: Dies on a site hit with Boom Bot and Paint Shells icons still lit
Satchel-jumps in alone with no flash, landing in front of three guns
Throws Paint Shells at nothing at round start just to use it
Showstopper fired at a single unconfirmed enemy behind cover
Uses both Blast Packs for movement and has none for a post-plant stall
Boom Bot sent down an obvious lane where it is shot instantly
ability_checks: Boom Bot (C) and Paint Shells (E) lit at death entering site means no corner was cleared
Both Blast Pack (Q) charges lit when she dies in the open means no reposition was available or used
Showstopper (X) ready across several rounds with no use is wasted round-winning damage
Paint Shells used before the team is ready to swing on the damaged enemy is a wasted nade
tips: Clear the corner with a bot before your body checks it
Nade a slowed or stalled enemy, not empty space
Satchel in behind a flash, not before it
Ult from an angle they have not pre-aimed

agents.name: Yoru

abilities.name: Fakeout
abilities.purpose: Decoy that walks forward with your last weapon and flashes when shot; bait a peek or fake a push.
abilities.when: Send the clone down the choke to draw the first shot
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Blindside
abilities.purpose: 1 bounce flash (1.5s); bounce off a wall then swing. Only one charge since 12.05.
abilities.when: Bounce it off the wall and swing on the flash
abilities.verdict: Buy every round: it is his only flash now

abilities.name: Gatecrash
abilities.purpose: Teleport beacon (20 HP, 20s active); use to enter behind a defender or to escape after a peek.
abilities.cost: free first, 150 for the second, resets every two kills
abilities.when: Send the teleport in early, take the site, then teleport in behind them
abilities.verdict: Buy the second on a full buy: his fakes need both

abilities.name: Dimensional Drift
abilities.purpose: Invisible walk to scout or reposition behind enemies; cannot cast Blindside or set Fakeout while in it.
abilities.when: A free info walk, or a reposition for a lurk

agents.job_in_round: On attack Yoru creates a second front: teleport behind the site or fake a push with Fakeout, then flash and entry when the team commits. On defense he takes an early flash-assisted pick and Gatecrashes out, or uses the ult to gather information for the retake.
good_play_looks_like: Gatecrash placed early to a flank spot, then used when the defenders are looking at the main push
Blindside bounced around the corner and swung immediately
Fakeout sent down a different lane than the actual push to split attention
Ult used before an execute to confirm defender positions and call them
Peeks with a pre-placed Gatecrash to escape after one duel
common_mistakes: Dies with Gatecrash beacon active and unused after taking a fight in the open
Solo teleports behind the site and dies with no team pressure on the front
Blindside thrown into open ground instead of bounced, blinding nobody
Fakeout walked straight down main, telegraphing the push
Ult walk that ends behind enemies with no call to the team and no follow-up
Gatecrash beacon placed in a spot the defenders naturally see and shoot
ability_checks: Gatecrash (E) icon lit or beacon active at death means the escape was not used
Blindside (Q) lit on an entry death means he dry-peeked with a flash in hand
Fakeout (C) never used across a half means the fake potential was ignored
Dimensional Drift (X) used but no kill or call followed it is wasted info
tips: Place the beacon before you take the fight, not after
Bounce every flash; a straight Blindside is a wasted charge
Fake with the decoy where they expect you, go where they don't
Time the flank to the team's push, not to your own boredom

agents.name: Neon

abilities.name: Fast Lane
abilities.purpose: Two electric walls that block vision; run a corridor into site without being shot from the sides.
abilities.when: Two walls down the choke so you can run in without a crossfire
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Relay Bolt
abilities.purpose: 2 bouncing concuss bolts (2.5s); stun the corner you are about to slide onto.
abilities.when: Bounce the concuss into the corner right before you slide in
abilities.verdict: Buy every round: it is what makes the slide survivable

abilities.name: High Gear
abilities.purpose: Sprint (16s) plus a slide; 60s recharge so the sprint must be planned, not toggled on a whim.
abilities.cost: free, slide resets every two kills
abilities.when: Sprint the rotate, slide the entry, and never slide into an unflashed angle
abilities.verdict: Free, and it is the whole agent

abilities.name: Overdrive
abilities.purpose: Lightning beam with accuracy while sprinting; use to entry and chain kills on a stacked site.
abilities.when: Take a site alone when they are a man down

agents.job_in_round: On attack Neon uses Fast Lane and Relay Bolt to sprint and slide into site before defenders can set up, forcing the opening duel. On defense she takes fast off-angle peeks or rotates quicker than anyone to rejoin a retake; the 60s High Gear recharge means one big sprint per round.
good_play_looks_like: Relay Bolt bounced onto a common defender spot, then slides in during the stun
Fast Lane thrown to walk from the main choke to the plant spot without side vision
High Gear saved for the execute, then used for the site entry
Overdrive popped to run through a stunned or smoked defender line
Slide is used to close a corner, not to peek a long angle
common_mistakes: Sprints into site with Relay Bolts unused and slides into a set angle
Uses High Gear at round start to run around, then has no sprint on the execute
Fast Lane placed after the team has already crossed
Stuns an empty corner while defenders are on the other side
Slides across a long open lane and gets shot at the end of the slide
Overdrive used at range instead of point-blank on a rush
ability_checks: Both Relay Bolt (Q) charges lit at death on entry means she never stunned her target corner
High Gear (E) on cooldown at execute time means the sprint was wasted earlier in the round
Fast Lane (C) still lit while she dies crossing an open lane is a wasted wall
Overdrive (X) ready for many rounds with no use is a wasted rush tool
tips: Stun then slide; never slide onto an unstunned corner
One sprint per round: spend it on the site hit
Wall your path before you run it
Ult up close on a stacked site, not from range

agents.name: Iso

abilities.name: Contingency
abilities.purpose: Indestructible bullet-blocking wall that moves forward; cross a lane or push a defender off an angle.
abilities.when: Push the wall through the choke and walk in behind it
abilities.verdict: Buy every round: an indestructible bullet block for 200

abilities.name: Undercut
abilities.purpose: Bolt that applies Vulnerable and Suppress for 4s through walls; throw before a peek to disable a Sentinel or Op angle.
abilities.when: Undercut through the wall before the peek to make the duel free
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can, it got expensive

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.purpose: Shield that absorbs one hit; orbs from downed enemies refresh it. Activate before every planned duel; instant weapon draw after cancel.
abilities.cost: free, refreshed by shooting orbs off damaged enemies
abilities.when: Get the shield up before the first duel, not after
abilities.verdict: Free: entering without the shield up is the Iso mistake

abilities.name: Kill Contract
abilities.purpose: Pulls one enemy into a 1v1 arena (36m); isolate the anchor or the Op player before the push.
abilities.when: Isolate their star player, or the last man on a retake

agents.job_in_round: On attack Iso activates Double Tap, Undercuts the angle he is about to peek, and takes the first duel with the shield up while the team enters. On defense he holds an aggressive angle with the shield, uses Contingency to escape or reposition, and ults the most dangerous enemy on a retake.
good_play_looks_like: Double Tap active and shield up before every entry duel
Undercut through a wall onto a known Sentinel setup before pushing it
Contingency walked forward to cross a sniper lane or plant behind
Shoots the energy orb after a kill to refresh the shield before the next duel
Kill Contract cast on the Op or anchor so the site is empty for the team
common_mistakes: Dies in a duel with Double Tap icon still lit (never activated)
Activates Double Tap and then waits so long the 12s window expires before the fight
Undercut thrown at nothing instead of through the wall onto a held angle
Contingency cast sideways or placed so teammates cannot use it
Kill Contract fired blind down a lane and hits nobody or the wrong target
Ignores the orb after a kill and enters the next fight shieldless
ability_checks: Double Tap (E) lit at death means the free shield was never used
Undercut (Q) lit when he dies to a set angle means the Vulnerable/Suppress was skipped
Contingency (C) lit at death crossing an open lane is a wasted wall
Kill Contract (X) ready across rounds with a strong Op enemy alive is a missed isolation
tips: Shield up before every planned peek
Undercut the angle, then swing it
Wall to cross, not to hide
Ult the enemy who wins the site, not the first one you see

agents.name: Waylay

abilities.name: Saturate
abilities.purpose: Bouncing light bomb that Hinders (slows everything) for 3s; bounce into a corner before you enter.
abilities.when: Hinder the anchor's angle right before you enter
abilities.verdict: Skip on a half buy

abilities.name: Light Speed
abilities.purpose: Two dashes, first one can go up; entry across a gap or escape after a duel.
abilities.when: Dash in after the flash; the second dash is your exit
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Refract
abilities.purpose: Drop a beacon, then return to it for a free peek; the escape after a first-contact duel.
abilities.when: Drop the beacon before you peek, recall it the moment you are traded on
abilities.verdict: Free: a get-out-of-jail card every round

abilities.name: Convergent Paths
abilities.purpose: Wide Hinder zone with an afterimage; aim restriction on enemies; use to break a stacked site or a retake.
abilities.when: Hinder the whole site for an execute

agents.job_in_round: On attack Waylay places Refract, dashes across the entry, takes the opening duel, and returns to safety, using Saturate to stop a defender from swinging. On defense she takes one fast off-angle fight and Refracts back before the trade, delaying pushes with Saturate on chokes.
good_play_looks_like: Refract beacon placed behind cover before the peek, then used after the first shot
Saturate bounced into the corner defenders hold, then a normal-speed swing
Light Speed double dash used to cross a lane and reach an off-angle in one go
Convergent Paths popped on a stacked site so the team walks in on Hindered enemies
Uses Light Speed's upward dash to reach unexpected height, then plays the timing
common_mistakes: Dies with Refract icon lit or beacon active but unused after a first duel
Dashes into site first without Saturate, landing on a hindered nobody
Refract placed in open ground so she returns into the same crossfire
Uses both Light Speed dashes to enter and has none to reposition
Saturate thrown at feet of teammates, slowing her own team
Ult used on an empty site or too early before the team is ready to swing
ability_checks: Refract (E) lit at death, or beacon still visible on the ground, means the free escape was unused
Saturate (C) lit at entry death means she skipped the Hinder on the defender angle
Light Speed (Q) with charges lit while she dies in the open means no dash out was taken
Convergent Paths (X) ready for multiple rounds without use is a wasted execute tool
tips: Beacon before the peek, every time
Saturate the corner, then walk in at normal speed
One dash in, keep one for out
Ult when the team is ready to push through it, not before

agents.name: Sova

abilities.name: Owl Drone
abilities.purpose: Pilot a drone to scout and tag one enemy; clear a corner or confirm site presence before entry.
abilities.when: Fly into site on a slow default to find the anchor before you commit
abilities.verdict: Full buy only: joint most expensive basic in the game

abilities.name: Shock Bolt
abilities.purpose: 2 bolts (damage); lineups on post-plant defusers or to punish a revealed enemy.
abilities.when: Bolt the default plant spot the moment the spike lands
abilities.verdict: Buy both every round, the cheapest damage utility going

abilities.name: Recon Bolt
abilities.purpose: Reveals enemies in a radius; the pre-execute and retake info tool, 50s cooldown.
abilities.when: Fire before the execute, then again after first contact
abilities.verdict: Free: two per round if you manage the cooldown

abilities.name: Hunter's Fury
abilities.purpose: 3 wall-piercing energy blasts; punish revealed or post-plant enemies through walls.
abilities.when: Wall-bang the choke you know they are stacked behind

agents.job_in_round: On attack Sova gives the team information before it commits: Recon Bolt the site, drone the close corners, and Shock Bolt any revealed enemy. On defense he recons the main choke early to see what is coming, then drones or recons for the retake.
good_play_looks_like: Recon Bolt fired from a lineup that lands where it cannot be shot, before the team pushes
Drone flown with a pre-planned path and a dart landed on the anchor
Shock Bolts thrown onto a revealed or defusing enemy, not at random
Calls what recon shows in a form teammates can act on
Hunter's Fury used through smoke or walls on enemies shown by recon
common_mistakes: Dies with Recon Bolt icon lit while the team executes blind
Drone flown straight down main and shot instantly with no dart
Recon Bolt fired into a spot it is immediately destroyed
Shock Bolts thrown at empty corners at round start
Uses the drone standing in the open and dies while piloting
Hunter's Fury fired at a guess without any reveal
ability_checks: Recon Bolt (E) lit at team execute or retake time means the info tool was not used
Owl Drone (C) unused across the half means close corners were never cleared for the entry
Shock Bolt (Q) charges full during a post-plant means no defuse denial
Hunter's Fury (X) ready for several rounds while enemies are revealed is a wasted punish
tips: Recon before the push, not after the entry dies
Drone with a plan: one corner, one dart
Shock a revealed target, not an empty corner
Stand behind cover when you pilot

agents.name: Breach

abilities.name: Aftershock
abilities.purpose: Delayed 3-burst damage through a wall; clear a corner, stall a defuse, or force a plant delay.
abilities.when: Burn the corner you know is held right before you swing
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Flashpoint
abilities.purpose: 2 through-wall flashes (2.25s); blind the site as teammates swing.
abilities.when: Flash through the wall for the entry, not after he is already in
abilities.verdict: Both on a full buy, one on a force

abilities.name: Fault Line
abilities.purpose: Long through-wall concuss (2.5s, 1.2s delay); stun the anchor then the team swings; 50s cooldown.
abilities.when: Stun the choke as the execute starts
abilities.verdict: Free and it recharges, so use it twice

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.purpose: Cascading concuss (18m wide); commit the team through it on a site or a retake.
abilities.when: Full-site stun for an execute or a retake

agents.job_in_round: On attack Breach flashes and stuns through the wall so the team can enter without dueling a set defender. On defense he delays pushes with Fault Line and Aftershock, and his flashes are the retake tool that lets teammates swing onto a site together.
good_play_looks_like: Flashpoint placed on a wall right next to the corner teammates are about to swing
Fault Line aimed at a known anchor spot with a teammate ready to peek during the 1.2s windup
Aftershock used to deny a defuse or clear a close corner before entry
Rolling Thunder timed with the whole team walking in behind it
Calls 'stun' and 'flash' timings so duelists can act on them
common_mistakes: Flashes with nobody ready to swing, or flashes his own teammates who are already peeking
Fault Line used with no teammate in position, stunning an empty area
Dies to a set angle with both Flashpoints and Fault Line still lit
Aftershock used at round start to check a corner nobody is going to push
Rolling Thunder cast into an empty site or after the team has already entered
Plays as first entry instead of behind the duelist
ability_checks: Flashpoint (Q) charges lit at team entry means no flash was thrown for the swing
Fault Line (E) lit while the team executes means the stun was not used to break the anchor
Aftershock (C) lit during a post-plant defuse means no denial
Rolling Thunder (X) ready across several rounds with no use is wasted retake power
tips: Flash for the swing, not for yourself
Stun a spot you know is held, with a teammate ready to peek
Aftershock the defuse, not an empty corner
Ult when the team walks in behind it

agents.name: Skye

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.purpose: Channel heal for allies in range; heal after the fight, never during it.
abilities.when: Heal the entry back up between fights, never mid-duel
abilities.verdict: Buy: 150 for 100 HP of pool

abilities.name: Trailblazer
abilities.purpose: Tiger that clears a corner and concusses (4s direct hit); pilot it into site before the entry.
abilities.when: Send it to concuss the anchor a second before your duelist enters
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Guiding Light
abilities.purpose: Controllable hawk flash; 60s cooldown so plan one at the execute, one at the retake.
abilities.cost: free first, 250 for the second, 50s recharge
abilities.when: Flash over the choke on a count with the entry
abilities.verdict: Buy the second every full buy: flashes are why she is picked

abilities.name: Seekers
abilities.purpose: Three seekers that track and nearsight the three closest enemies; reveal positions before a push.
abilities.when: Flush a stacked site or break a post-plant

agents.job_in_round: On attack Skye scouts with Trailblazer, flashes with Guiding Light as the team swings, and heals after site is taken. On defense she flashes to let a teammate re-peek, uses the tiger to stall or check, and saves Seekers to open a retake.
good_play_looks_like: Hawk flown through a hidden path and popped with teammates already moving to swing
Trailblazer sent into the close corner before the duelist peeks, with the team ready to swing on the stun
Regrowth channeled from cover after the fight when multiple teammates are low
Seekers cast at the start of a retake or a push so the team knows where all three are
Varies hawk launch points round to round
common_mistakes: Flashes at round start to scout, then has no flash for the execute (60s cooldown)
Pops the hawk too early or in view, flashing nobody or her own team
Channels Regrowth in the open or while the team is taking a site
Tiger flown down an obvious lane and shot without a stun
Dies with Guiding Light lit on a site hit or retake
Uses Seekers only to finish a round instead of to open it
ability_checks: Guiding Light (E) lit at execute or retake death means the flash was not used
Trailblazer (Q) lit when the team walks into an unchecked corner means no scout was sent
Regrowth (C) unused across the half while teammates fight at low HP means the heal was skipped
Seekers (X) ready and unused during a full retake is a wasted reveal
tips: One flash per minute: spend it on the swing
Tiger the corner, then teammates swing on the stun
Heal behind cover after the fight
Seekers open the retake, they do not end it

agents.name: KAY/O

abilities.name: FRAG/ment
abilities.purpose: Lingering damage pulses; deny a plant or defuse, or clear a close corner.
abilities.when: Throw it on the spike to deny the defuse
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: FLASH/drive
abilities.purpose: 2 flashes, right-click for a short 2.25s underhand pop-flash around corners.
abilities.when: Both on the execute, pop-flashing the entry angle
abilities.verdict: Buy both, the whole reason he is picked

abilities.name: ZERO/point
abilities.purpose: Suppression blade that disables abilities and reveals who is hit; throw before a push or retake; 50s cooldown.
abilities.when: Knife the site before the execute to delete the sentinel's utility
abilities.verdict: Free: throw it every single round

abilities.name: NULL/cmd
abilities.purpose: Pulsing suppression plus combat stim and downed-state revival; pop at the start of a site hit or retake.

abilities.purpose: Camera with a dart; revealed within 8m when inactive, so place it high and out of foot traffic.
abilities.when: Cam on info duty early, then recall and re-place after the rotate
abilities.verdict: Free: one placement a round is a wasted cam

abilities.name: Neural Theft
abilities.purpose: Reveal all enemies from a corpse; use before a push or retake to see rotations.
abilities.when: Use it on a corpse right before the retake

agents.job_in_round: On attack Cypher wires the flank behind the team, places a cam to watch the retake path, and uses cages to block a defuse angle. On defense he sets up a site with wires and cam so he can hold it alone, calls what the cam shows, and moves setups round to round.
good_play_looks_like: Trapwires placed at unusual heights and spots, moved between rounds
Spycam placed high or off the walking path so it survives the 8m reveal
Cyber Cage activated once the enemy is actually inside it
Wire placed on the flank on attack so the team can push forward safely
Neural Theft used before a push or retake, not after the round is decided
common_mistakes: Same head-height wire in the same spot every round, broken in the first 3s
Cam placed at ground level near a choke and shot immediately
Watches the cam standing in the open and dies mid-view
Dies with Trapwire charges lit on attack with no flank cover
Cages thrown at round start at nothing
Neural Theft never used across a half
ability_checks: Trapwire (C) charges lit at death, on either side, means no flank/site coverage was placed
Spycam (E) lit throughout a round means no info tool was deployed
Cyber Cage (Q) charges lit during a defuse or push through a choke means no block was used
Neural Theft (X) ready across rounds with a corpse available is wasted info
tips: Move your wires every couple of rounds
Cam high, out of the walking path
Cage when they are in it, not before
Watch the cam from cover

agents.name: Killjoy

abilities.name: Nanoswarm
abilities.purpose: 2 hidden damage grenades (5s); deny a plant/defuse or punish a choke.
abilities.when: Swarm the spike to deny the defuse, not for chip damage
abilities.verdict: Buy both on a full buy

abilities.name: Alarmbot
abilities.purpose: Hidden bot (20 HP) that Vulnerables; place at the edge of an entry so it is hard to shoot early.
abilities.when: Tuck it in the flank corridor you cannot watch
abilities.verdict: Buy every round, the cheapest flank insurance

abilities.name: Turret
abilities.purpose: Auto-firing turret; place elevated or off-angle to spot and tag pushes; 2s reactivation.
abilities.when: Cover the off-angle at round start, re-place it after you rotate
abilities.verdict: Free: pick it up and move it, do not leave it dead

abilities.name: Lockdown
abilities.purpose: Detains enemies in a large radius after a windup; clear a site for a retake or force attackers off a plant.
abilities.when: Detain a retake or force a site off

agents.job_in_round: On attack Killjoy places the turret to watch the flank, Nanoswarms for post-plant denial, and the Alarmbot on the retake path. On defense she anchors a site with turret and bot in non-standard spots, stays within range so they stay active, and Lockdowns to clear a taken site.
good_play_looks_like: Turret placed elevated or unexpected, where it survives long enough to tag
Alarmbot at the edge or corner of an entry, not the middle of the doorway
Nanoswarms placed on the plant spot and activated on the defuse
Stays within utility range so nothing deactivates
Lockdown cast from safety with the team ready to retake
common_mistakes: Turret placed center-site at head height and destroyed instantly
Rotates away from the site and all utility deactivates
Dies with both Nanoswarms lit during a post-plant defuse
Alarmbot placed in the open where it is shot before triggering
Lockdown cast into an empty site or too late to matter
Never places anything on attack, leaving the flank open
ability_checks: Nanoswarm (C) charges lit during a post-plant means no denial was set
Turret (E) or Alarmbot (Q) lit at death on defense means the site was never set up
Utility greyed out on the HUD means she walked out of range and left it inactive
Lockdown (X) ready across rounds with the site lost is a wasted retake
tips: Turret high, bot on the edge
Swarms belong to the spike
Stay in range or your setup is off
Lockdown from cover, with the team ready

agents.name: Chamber

abilities.name: Trademark
abilities.purpose: 1 trap with no range restriction that slows 50%; watch a flank or the retake path.
abilities.when: Cover the flank you are leaving when you take an aggressive angle
abilities.verdict: Buy when you can

abilities.name: Headhunter
abilities.purpose: Heavy pistol (100 per bullet) that one-taps heads; eco and save-round pick tool.
abilities.when: Buy two or three bullets on an eco and hold a head-level angle
abilities.verdict: The best eco purchase in the game

abilities.name: Rendezvous
abilities.purpose: Single anchor, 18m teleport radius; place it before the peek and teleport out after the first shot.
abilities.when: Anchor behind cover, peek wide, teleport out after you tag
abilities.verdict: Free: never hold an angle without the anchor placed

abilities.name: Tour de Force
abilities.purpose: Custom sniper that kills on upper-body hit and slows on kill; hold long angles on defense or a post-plant.
abilities.when: A free Operator on a save or a retake

agents.job_in_round: On attack Chamber places Trademark on the flank, takes an aggressive early pick with Rendezvous placed, and plays Operator or Headhunter angles in post-plant. On defense he holds a long angle with the anchor placed within range, takes one shot, teleports out, and uses Trademark to watch the other entry.

Takes one Op or Headhunter shot, teleports, and re-peeks from the new spot
Trademark placed on the flank or the retake path where it is not immediately shot
Tour de Force used to hold a long angle where the slow field on kill matters

Peeks aggressively with no anchor placed, then cannot escape

Stays on the first angle after the anchor is destroyed or used

Tour de Force (X) ready across rounds with long angles available is wasted

One shot, then teleport
Trademark the flank, hidden
Headhunter is for heads, not sprays

agents.name: Deadlock

abilities.name: Barrier Mesh
abilities.purpose: Movement-blocking wall (300 credits); seal a choke with both edges touching walls, fortify to hold.
abilities.when: Mesh the choke to force them into a single entry
abilities.verdict: First thing to cut

abilities.name: Sonic Sensor
abilities.purpose: Concusses (2.5s) when noise is made in range; place on the spike or an active entry, not a quiet flank.
abilities.when: One on flank, one on the site entry you are not looking at
abilities.verdict: Buy one always

abilities.name: GravNet
abilities.purpose: Free grenade (50s cooldown) that crouches and slows; throw just before a teammate peeks.
abilities.when: Throw it as they enter site to force crouch-walk speed
abilities.verdict: Free: use it on the push, not pre-placed

abilities.name: Annihilation
abilities.purpose: Captures the first enemy hit and drags them; use on a retake or a 1v1 with a practised lineup.
abilities.when: Pick off the last man or break a post-plant

agents.job_in_round: On attack Deadlock uses GravNet on a held corner as a teammate swings, walls the retake path, and places a sensor on the spike. On defense she seals a choke with Barrier Mesh, sensors the loud entries, and uses GravNet to stall or set up a kill; she is best on maps with a single main lane.

Barrier Mesh placed so both edges touch geometry and enemies cannot step around it
Sonic Sensor placed on the planted spike or a loud active entry
Annihilation used from a known lineup on a retake or clutch

common_mistakes: Sonic Sensor placed on a quiet flank that walkers bypass without noise
GravNet thrown after the fight has already started, or dies with it lit

Annihilation (X) ready across rounds with retakes lost is a wasted clutch tool

Sensors go where they make noise: the spike
Wall edge to edge or it is a doorway
The wall blocks feet, not bullets

agents.name: Vyse

abilities.name: Razorvine
abilities.purpose: 2 invisible nests that slow and damage when activated; corner or post-plant denial.

abilities.verdict: Buy both at 150 each

abilities.purpose: Hidden wall trap that isolates the enemy who crosses; place on an entry to cut a push in half.

Activate vines when they are in them
Shear the entry, isolate the first one in
Ult from cover, then the team swings
